title: My dream world burned down
content: New to this Reddit and just heard about it. I was having dreams about this specific mall. It doesn’t just start at the mall either it could also include me going to the mall by bus or car. It had a tattoo parlor and video game shop including other things I enjoy a lot. I can tell I’m not an adult in these dreams but I’m more late teens. It will include people I know or made up people I have reoccurring in my dreams. I had dreamt of this place for most my adult life (I’m now 24) beginning of this year the mall has burned down in my dreams. I wasn’t inside but I was in the car with family as we drove by I started panicking thinking about everyone I knew that would frequent the mall and wanted to make sure everyone was okay, I woke up and was unable to get closure on the dream and haven’t had a dream with the location since. I’m really saddened by this honestly and I try to make sense of everything but I also can’t help but feel those people I made up in my dreams I had some sort of odd connection to and honestly miss. Anyways thank you for reading this far there’s not much else to state on it but willing to answer any questions!
